D3 REFERENCE JUMPING -- LOW RATE, CATASTROPHIC MAGNITUDE. On MCS ground truth over 1,090 clean pairs: anchor maps A->B 676 (62%); anchor OUTSIDE the MCS 157 (14.4%); A's reference ring has NO image in B 254 (23%, unanswerable); REFERENCE JUMPED 32/836 answerable = 3.83%. Label error on jumped pairs: median 4 bonds, mean 5.41, max 13 -- against a span whose OWN median is 3 and mean 2.39, with 87% of mass in 0-6. THE ERROR IS LARGER THAN THE QUANTITY: on a jumped pair the label is not a perturbation of the truth, it is unrelated to it. Rate is low enough to DROP.

D4 NEW, INDEPENDENT OF PAIRING, AND CHEAP TO FIX -- flex depends on an ARBITRARY SHORTEST PATH. Chem.GetShortestPath returns ONE path; ties are an RDKit traversal detail. Over 17,236 molecules: >1 equal-length anchor->ring path in 2,212 = 12.83%; flex CHANGES with the choice in 1,159 = 6.72%, mean spread 1.10 rotatable bonds against a flex median of 3 -- ~30% of the median value decided by traversal order. FIX: define the neighbourhood over the UNION of all shortest anchor->ring paths (deterministic, order-free). One function, no dependency on any pairing decision. DO THIS FIRST.

D5 FATAL, AND IT SUPERSEDES D3's SEVERITY ASSESSMENT. D3 quoted a 3.83% reference-jump rate on clean pairs. That number is real and USELESS: it is dominated by pairs whose span does not change, i.e. rows carrying NO training signal. Conditioned on STEERABLE rows (naive delta != 0 -- the only rows the model learns from), MCS adjudication over n=900 audited gives: mcsfail 130, UNANSWERABLE 349 (38.8% -- A's reference ring has NO image in B), answerable 421, of which REF JUMPED 160 = 38.0% OF ANSWERABLE. Only 261/900 = 29% are verifiably sound. |label error| on jumped rows: median 3, mean 3.88, max 13 -- against a span whose own median is 3. AND THE DIRECTION LABEL, WHICH IS WHAT WE TRAIN ON, SURVIVES ONLY 22/160 = 13.8%: DOWN->SAME 92, DOWN->UP 46, UP->UP 17, DOWN->DOWN 5. THE ERROR IS ASYMMETRIC: steerable rows split DOWN 51.7% / UP 48.3%, but jumped rows are 143/160 = 89% naive-DOWN, implying DOWN ~66% contaminated vs UP ~8%, an ~8x asymmetry. That is a SYSTEMATIC BIAS in the steering channel, not noise: a model trained on this learns 'decrease the span' as 'a ring got added somewhere else'. ROOT CAUSE, which is close to definitional: on rows where span CHANGES, the edit is BY CONSTRUCTION near the warhead, so the anchor lies OUTSIDE the MCS on 603/770 = 78% of them (vs 14.4% over all clean pairs). The MMP premise 'same core, same attachment, one substituent differs' -- which GUARANTEED reference correspondence -- is absent on exactly the rows that matter. All-vs-all pairing removed the thing that made the param well-defined. POOLED OVER ALL PAIRS THE CONTAMINATION IS ~2%; POOLED OVER TRAINING-SIGNAL ROWS IT IS ~38%. Anyone quoting the pooled rate concludes the corpus is safe. It is not.

RECOMMENDATION_VERIFY_NOT_FILTER:
Label all pairs. Take SAME rows at face value (1.2% contaminated). MCS-adjudicate ONLY the STEERABLE rows -- ~6% of the corpus, ~90k pairs, ~1.3 s/pair single-core = ~32 core-hours, ~4 h on 8 cores. Keep REF STABLE; drop or hard-tag REF JUMPED; hard-tag UNANSWERABLE SEPARATELY (38.8% of steerable rows are not checkable at all and must not be silently merged into 'clean'). YIELD: 25,000 sampled -> 22,042 evaluable -> 16,517 clean -> 1,535 steerable -> ~29% verified stable. Scaled to 1.47M pairs: ~26,000 VERIFIED steerable span labels.
CHEAPER CUT: MCS only the DOWN rows (59.7% contaminated) and light-check UP (8.6%). Halves the bill and removes most of the bias, but leaves an 8.6% residual and a class imbalance -- state it.
YIELD REVISED UP on the full-population run: 506 verified-stable of 1,535 clean steerable in the 25k sample scales to ~29,800 verified steerable span labels, not ~26,000.
THE_FREE_ALTERNATIVE_USER_DECISION: RENAME THE INSTRUCTION. If the channel is 'bring the warhead closer to / further from ring-land' -- a DESCRIPTIVE geometric relation -- then the DOWN labels are CORRECT, nothing needs dropping or verifying, and all 1,470,338 pairs survive at zero cost. What it costs is THE CLAIM: the channel can no longer be described as a LINKER edit, because ~60% of its DOWN examples are ring additions, and the stamp must say so. D7_TAUTOMERS_ANSWERED: Previously flagged UNMEASURED; now measured on 1,500 molecules under RDKit canonical tautomer, and the answer is not the expected one. THE VALUE IS ROBUST: span CHANGES on only 11/1500 = 0.73% (shifts +2 x5, +1 x3, -3 x2, -1 x1) -- a non-issue. BUT THE ANCHOR EXISTS OR NOT depending on the tautomer for 184/1500 = 12.27% of molecules (warhead or ring lost entirely). THIS BITES HERE SPECIFICALLY because pairs_mw800 mixes sources: 228,445 pairs are CROSS (ChEMBL x CovInDB) and each database records whatever tautomer its curator entered, so the SAME compound can be anchorable from one source and unanchorable from the other. That turns a tautomer convention into a SILENT COVERAGE BIAS CORRELATED WITH pair_source. FIX (fourth free fix): canonicalise tautomers ONCE at corpus build, before labelling, and stamp which enumerator -- not because span moves, but because the anchor's EXISTENCE does.

D8_MEDCHEM_VERDICT_SPAN_IS_DEAD:
A COVALENT MEDCHEM CONSULT KILLS warhead_span UNDER BOTH READINGS. A and B were the wrong question; the param is worse than either assumed.
(1) span IS NOT A CONTINUOUS LENGTH -- it is a 3-LEVEL CATEGORICAL. Over 14,278 warhead-matched molecules: span=1 40.4%, span=3 27.5%, span=4 25.7% = 93.6% in {1,3,4}; span=2 is 2.0%, span=5 is 0.6%. There is nothing to steer ALONG.
(2) THE span=1 CLASS IS A DIFFERENT WARHEAD, NOT A SHORT LINKER. 34% of it is aryl-conjugated Michael acceptors -- cinnamamide/chalcone/curcuminoid -- where the beta carbon sits directly on a phenyl, so span=1 BY CONSTRUCTION. A styryl Michael acceptor is a natural-product frequent hitter, not a designed TCI electrophile.
(3) SO THE DOWN LABEL IS MOSTLY 'ACRYLAMIDE -> CINNAMAMIDE'. In a 20-pair DOWN sample, 17/20 land at span=1 in B and 16/20 flip conjugation status. Verbatim example:
    A  C=CC(=O)NCCc1ccccc1                      span 6
    B  O=C(/C=C/c1ccc(O)cc1)NCCc1ccccc1         span 1   labelled DOWN -5
The phenethylamide is UNTOUCHED. Nobody shortened anything -- a terminal acrylamide was replaced by a p-coumaroyl amide. That is a WARHEAD IDENTITY change (different kinact, different reversibility) being taught as 'shorten the linker by 5'.
(4) THE KILLER, ON APPROVED DRUGS. ibrutinib 3, zanubrutinib 3, acalabrutinib 3, ritlecitinib 3, sotorasib 3, adagrasib 3, futibatinib 3, osimertinib 4, afatinib 4, neratinib 4, dacomitinib 2. EVERY MARKETED TCI IS 3 OR 4 -- the entire clinically validated design space occupies ONE UNIT of this variable. And afatinib/neratinib/dacomitinib are the SAME 2nd-gen EGFR crotonamide series making the SAME move (basic amine tail on the acrylamide): afatinib's NMe2 gives span 4, dacomitinib's piperidine gives span 2. The param does not measure the design move consistently WITHIN ONE DRUG SERIES.
(5) WHAT THE QUANTITY ACTUALLY IS: for an acrylamide the beta-C->N distance is fixed at 3, so span = 3 + (N to ring). It reads 3 when the amide N is ENDOCYCLIC (ibrutinib piperidine, sotorasib piperazine), 4 for an anilide (osimertinib), 5-6 with a CH2 spacer -- and it can resolve BACKWARDS down a solubilising tail (dacomitinib). So span is mostly 'is the acylated nitrogen endocyclic or exocyclic, unless something cyclic hangs off the other end'.
COST OF READING B, RESTATED BY THE CHEMIST: 'warhead sits closer to ring-land' is not a property chemists have a name for and is not monotone in anything they optimise. Keeping all 1.47M means training 'move the warhead toward a ring' on a corpus where obeying it means 'swap the acrylamide for a cinnamamide' 80%+ of the time. That is not a naming concession.
D8_PROPOSED_REPLACEMENTS: From the chemist, provisional pending their final ranking: (a) n ATOMS between the acylated heteroatom and the electrophile -- the linker proper, DIRECTION-RESTRICTED toward the scaffold so it cannot resolve backwards down a tail; (b) ENDOCYCLIC-vs-EXOCYCLIC acyl nitrogen + RING SIZE -- a 3-way categorical that IS the real named move (exocyclic-NH-acrylamide -> N-acyl azetidine/pyrrolidine/piperidine ring walk, which constrains the warhead vector, controls the amide rotamer and removes a rotatable bond); (c) exit-vector angle; (d) WARHEAD CLASS HELD FIXED as a PRECONDITION on any linker instruction. Real design vocabulary is kinact/KI, the Cys distance and the amide rotamer -- never a bond count to ring-land.
D9_MEDCHEM_FINAL_KILL_AND_PIVOT:
CHEMIST'S FINAL: Reading A vs B is a FALSE DICHOTOMY. Route (ii) is a SYMPTOM; the disease is that span is a MIN OVER ALL DIRECTIONS, so it is structurally incapable of being a linker descriptor. Do not filter, do not rename -- RE-PARAMETERISE.
[1] NOT A LENGTH, A 3-LEVEL CATEGORICAL: span=1 40.4%, span=3 27.5%, span=4 25.7% = 93.6%. span=2 is 2.0%, span=5 0.6%. There is no ladder to climb.
[2] THE span=1 BUCKET IS NOT COVALENT CHEMISTRY -- AND THIS IS A CORPUS BUG, NOT JUST A PARAM BUG. It is 78% arylidene/beta-aryl Michael acceptors, 18% ring-embedded (maleimides, cyclic enones). Molecules our `C=CC(=O)N` SMARTS pulled in and stamped 'acrylamide': SUNITINIB (a marketed NON-COVALENT kinase inhibitor), nintedanib oxindole, rhodanines/TZDs (textbook PAINS), N-ethylmaleimide (a thiol-capping REAGENT). So 'span DOWN' is mostly 'turn your TCI into a frequent hitter'. THE WARHEAD PANEL IS ADMITTING NON-COVALENT COMPOUNDS -- that contaminates the whole corpus, not only span.
[3] EVERY APPROVED TCI SITS IN ONE UNIT: ibrutinib/zanubrutinib/acalabrutinib/ritlecitinib/sotorasib/adagrasib/futibatinib 3; osimertinib/afatinib/neratinib 4; dacomitinib 2. Afatinib, neratinib and dacomitinib are the SAME EGFR crotonamide series making the SAME move (basic amine tail on the beta-carbon): NMe2 -> span 4, piperidine -> span 2. ROUTE (ii) HAPPENS INSIDE ONE MARKETED DRUG SERIES. You cannot filter your way out of a definition.
[4] THE PATH POINTS THE WRONG WAY HALF THE TIME. For span>=2 the shortest path traverses the acyl heteroatom (toward the scaffold) in only 49.6% of molecules; the other 50.4% runs out along the warhead tail, AWAY from the recognition scaffold. `min` over directions silently switches between two chemically OPPOSITE quantities. Route (ii) is IN THE DEFINITION.
EXAMPLE FROM OUR OWN FILE: A C=CC(=O)Nc1cc2c(Nc3ccc(F)c(Cl)c3)ncnc2s1 span 4 -> B O=C(/C=C/CN1CCOCC1)Nc1cc2c(...)ncnc2s1 span 2, labelled DOWN -2. The anilide NH and the core are UNTOUCHED; a morpholinomethyl was appended to the acrylamide beta-position -- the warhead grew a tail POINTING AWAY from the core. That is the afatinib move, labelled 'bring the warhead 2 bonds closer'.
EVEN THE CLEAN SUBSET FUSES OPPOSITE MOVES: restricted to same-class non-conjugated warheads (n=1061), 95.7% are SAME; of 46 movers the -1 rows are one real move (exocyclic N -> endocyclic N acylation) and the -2 rows are the crotonamide tail move, i.e. the OPPOSITE intent under the same label.
D9_REPLACEMENTS_RANKED:
(a) ACYL-NITROGEN MOTIF, CATEGORICAL: {ArNH-, alkyl-NH-, N-Me-aryl, endocyclic ring-4, ring-5, ring-6, fused/indoline}. Every level is a sentence a chemist says out loud, and it IS the signal inside the -1 rows. BUILD THIS FIRST.
(b) DIRECTION-RESTRICTED LINKER ATOM COUNT: atoms strictly between the electrophilic carbon and the first ring encountered walking THROUGH the carbonyl and acyl heteroatom TOWARD the Murcko scaffold -- NOT min over all rings. This is Reading A implemented correctly: route (ii) becomes IMPOSSIBLE BY CONSTRUCTION rather than filtered at a 97% cost.
(c) EXIT-VECTOR ANGLE: the only candidate that captures the ortho/meta/para acrylamide walk -- THE most common warhead-placement edit in EGFR/BTK hit-to-lead, and span is exactly 4 for all three positions, i.e. completely blind to it. Do the 2D TOPOLOGICAL version first; this repo has been burnt on conformer deltas being seed lotteries (#143/#178).
(d) MICHAEL-ACCEPTOR SUBSTITUTION CLASS: {terminal, beta-aryl/conjugated, beta-amino, alpha-cyano, alpha-substituted, ring-embedded}. Cheap, discrete, and it is what separates ibrutinib from a rhodanine. This information is currently COLLAPSED INTO span, which is why span appears to move.
(e) kinact/KI descriptors: SKIP, no data to ground them; (d) is the 80% proxy.
NON-NEGOTIABLE PRECONDITION for any linker/placement instruction: warhead class AND CONJUGATION STATUS identical between A and B. In the chemist's DOWN sample 16/20 flipped conjugation.
D10_ROTOR_SMARTS_BUG:
REAL BUG, INDEPENDENT OF EVERYTHING ELSE. Our rotor SMARTS [!$(*#*)&!D1]-&!@[!$(*#*)&!D1] COUNTS THE AMIDE C-N AS ROTATABLE. C=CC(=O)Nc1ccccc1 -> 3 by our SMARTS, 2 by RDKit default AND RDKit Strict. Every acrylamide in the corpus carries a +1 from a bond with a ~18 kcal/mol barrier no chemist calls a rotor. It cancels in most deltas, but EVERY LEVEL WE HAVE QUOTED IS INFLATED BY ONE.
And flex is mostly a restatement of span plus size: corr(flex3, span) = 0.554, corr(flex3, whole-molecule rotB) = 0.494, mean flex3 by span = 2.50 / 2.89 / 4.12 for span 1/3/4.
